name: A.I. Apartment
desc:
✨ Welcome to AI Apartment!
👀 Visit an Apartment deep in the countryside, where there is something off about all the residents. CHAT WITH NPCs, who might be AI, EXPLORE THE MAP, COLLECT BADGES, UNCOVER THE HIDDEN SECRETS.

🤔 You will find that the apartment is not what you think.. AI Apartment is an open world game, with infinite possibilities!

📽️If you get stuck, there are lots of tutorials online! 📽️

AI Apartment is fully family safe. By chatting you're only chatting with custom home made AI. No humans, nor chat logging ever!

⚠️BEWARE - NPCs WILL DEFEND THEMSELVES! ⚠️
